children: Investors are likely to welcome Anheuser-Busch InBev's growth ambitions, analysts at Berenberg write. The brewer behind Bud Light, Michelob and Stella Artois backed its midterm earnings-growth ambitions at an investor event this week, and detailed its plans to achieve that growth, including through investment in its biggest brands and chasing growth in other categories too. "AB InBev's ambition is to deliver consistent growth that can compound, which will in turn provide the group with more flexibility on capital allocation now that leverage is low," Berenberg says. "We expect this vision to be welcomed by investors." (joshua.kirby@wsj.com)
